# UC-187 — Configure the Payout Account

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-187
- **Title:** Configure the Payout Account
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Owner
- **Trigger:** The Owner sets or changes the bank/mobile-wallet destination used for payouts
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Store a payout destination that passes the payout gate so released escrow can be paid out.
- **Preconditions:** Caller is the Owner; store_id scoping per BR-VND-07; KYC = APPROVED and store not suspended required to save (BR-ESC-06).

## Main Scenario
1. Owner opens Payout settings → client `GET /store/payout-account` (`API-VND-020`) returns `method`, `bankName`, `accountMasked`, `holderName`, `verifiedAt` — masked, the full number is never returned.
2. No account configured yet → `NOT_FOUND` → the empty configuration form is shown.
3. Owner enters `{ method, bankName?, accountNumber, holderName }` → `PUT /store/payout-account` (`API-VND-021`).
4. System validates KYC = APPROVED and store not suspended (BR-ESC-06), stores the account number write-only, and clears `verifiedAt` until re-verification after the change.
5. System writes an audit entry for the change (BR-PLT-06); payout requests stay gated until the account passes the payout gate (BR-ESC-06).

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — First-time setup:** no prior account → create; `verifiedAt` is set once verification completes, enabling payouts (BR-ESC-06).
- **A2 — Read-only display:** subsequent reads show only the masked number and holder name; the full number is never echoed back.

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — KYC not approved:** `KYC_NOT_APPROVED` → save refused, previous account untouched (BR-ESC-06).
- **E2 — Store suspended:** `STORE_SUSPENDED` → save refused while suspension lasts (BR-ESC-06).
- **E3 — Invalid payload:** missing holder or malformed account → `VALIDATION_ERROR`; nothing is written.

## Postconditions
- Payout account stored write-only (or unchanged on failure); `verifiedAt` reflects verification state (BR-ESC-06).
- Audit entry records actor, action, and before/after values (BR-PLT-06).

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-ESC-06, BR-PLT-06

## Related Requirements
- FR-014 (Escrow, Commission & Vendor Payouts)

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Owner only — the payout destination is an Owner capability; read returns masked data exclusively.
- **Data involved:** payout account (bank or mobile wallet), masked read model, audit log.
- **External dependencies:** batched payout execution engine (destination consumed at execution time).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC187-01:** Given KYC is not `APPROVED`, when saving, then `KYC_NOT_APPROVED` is returned and nothing is stored (BR-ESC-06).
- **AC-UC187-02:** Given a valid account saved by the Owner, when read back, then only the masked number is returned.
- **AC-UC187-03:** Given the destination changed, when saved, then `verifiedAt` is cleared until re-verification (BR-ESC-06).
- **AC-UC187-04:** Given any save, when committed, then an audit entry with actor and before/after values is appended (BR-PLT-06).
